name: CredentialRequirements Issuer (DCQL verifier)
description: Issues a Membership Card only after a National ID requested with a DCQL query has been presented
summary: NOOP wallet illustrating a CredentialRequirements issuer whose referenced verifier requests the required credential with a DCQL query (dc+sd-jwt) instead of a DIF Presentation Exchange definition. A Membership Card (jwt_vc_vcdm) is issued only once the holder presents a valid National ID; unlike a VPDriven issuer there is no mapping, the presentation is a gate. Required field values are supplied per request at CredentialIssuanceInit. Use DCQL when interfacing with the EUDI wallet. Works only with the in-time authorized issuance flow.
